meta.title: feat: Add timeout to sync Ids to prevent spinner hangs on slow connections & edge cases
meta.body_summary: Add a 10-second automatic timeout to sync IDs to prevent the loading spinner from hanging indefinitely on slow networks or edge cases.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added 10s sync timeout with tests; maintainer made minor comments/formatting tweaks and approved; merged rapidly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 241 changed lines (though lockfile accounts for ~100), this is a small, additive performance fix. It fits a fast-turnaround, low-risk improvement and was merged with a single approval after minor maintainer housekeeping.

review_details.concern_detail: No explicit review concerns recorded; maintainer added clarifying comments and merged after minor commits.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding a 10-second automatic timeout removes hung spinners caused by slow networks or failed APIs.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a timeout mechanism in existing state management is within Copilot's capability; merge required no special evidence and maintainer contributed minor code comments.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer rossbulat reviewed the timeout logic, added clarifying comments in a follow‑up commit, and approved with no further feedback.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests cover timeout behaviour, but no benchmark or profiling evidence is provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression issues surfaced; PR merged without incident.

core_change_summary.description: Added 10‑second automatic timeout to sync IDs: a new Map tracks timers, setSyncing starts a timer, removeSyncing clears it, and setSyncingMulti handles multiple IDs. A constant SyncTimeoutDuration was added in packages/consts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Secondary changes arise from merging main (lockfile, package.json adjustments) and routine lint/dependabot fixes.
change_trajectory: Copilot initial implementation: timeout logic, tests, and new constant.

Approval without further review comments; merged within ~1.8 hours.
